column4: notes

Kernel does NOT delegate to NtAllocateVirtualMemoryEx (it calls MiAllocateVirtualMemoryPrepare+MiAllocateVirtualMemory directly), but sogen's handle_NtAllocateVirtualMemory does call handle_NtAllocateVirtualMemoryEx with count=0 extended params — a valid superset delegation; claim "delegates to ...Ex" is accurate for the sogen implementation
Kernel calls MmAllocateVirtualMemory; sogen implements full logic including PAGE_WRITECOPY rejection and MEM_RESET handling, matching kernel semantics
Kernel returns STATUS_INVALID_HANDLE (-1073741816) for non-existent/invalid handles; sogen returns STATUS_INVALID_HANDLE when handle_store->erase(h) fails or store is null
Kernel resolves both via ObReferenceObjectByHandle, returns STATUS_NOT_SAME_OBJECT (0xC00001AC) if pointers differ; sogen resolve_object_pseudo_handle + equality comparison maps to same semantics
Kernel delegates to MiCreateSectionCommon; sogen independently checks no-file && !maximum_size -> STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER at section.cpp:162-163

Kernel calls ObDuplicateObject for any process combination; sogen returns STATUS_NOT_SUPPORTED for cross-process (both source and target must be current-process handles); claim correctly identifies the cross-process branch

Kernel checks overflow (v11+v13<v11) and ceiling (>0x7FFFFFFEFFFFLL) returning STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER; writes base back as v18 & ~0xFFF; sogen has aligned_end<=aligned_start guard and base_address.write(aligned_start)

Kernel delegates to MmFreeVirtualMemory without visible free_type==0 check in stub; sogen explicitly checks free_type==0 -> STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER_4 at memory.cpp:473, which is the documented Windows behavior implemented here
Kernel calls MiMapViewOfSectionCommon with both process handle params; sogen rejects non-current-process with STATUS_INVALID_HANDLE at section.cpp:289-291; claimed process check is present
Kernel is a single call to MiMapViewOfSectionExCommon; sogen validates extended params then delegates to handle_NtMapViewOfSection at section.cpp:547
Kernel uses ObOpenObjectByNameEx for name lookup; sogen performs name lookup through special-case table and proc.sections store, returning STATUS_OBJECT_NAME_NOT_FOUND at section.cpp:276
Kernel: !v17 (zero size) -> STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER at line 65; sogen added orig_length==0 check at memory.cpp:274; fix is present

Kernel: if (v5 != 56) return STATUS_INFO_LENGTH_MISMATCH for ObjectBasicInformation at line 131; sogen: object_information_length != sizeof(OBJECT_BASIC_INFORMATION) -> STATUS_INFO_LENGTH_MISMATCH at object.cpp:402; fix is present
Kernel returns STATUS_INVALID_INFO_CLASS (0xC0000003 = 3221225475) for class not in {0,1,2,3}; sogen default case returns STATUS_INVALID_INFO_CLASS at section.cpp:849; fix is present

Kernel has no early reject of SACL-only queries; access rights are computed from security_information bits without rejecting SACL_SECURITY_INFORMATION; sogen rejects only security_information==0 at object.cpp:773; fix is present
Kernel is a single call to MmQueryVirtualMemory; sogen has full dispatch with MemoryBasicInformation handler at memory.cpp:147; dispatch is present
Kernel: MiReadWriteVirtualMemory(a1,a5,16,0); sogen does page-by-page loop at memory.cpp:598-625 returning STATUS_PARTIAL_COPY when partial; partial copy path confirmed

Kernel: returns STATUS_INVALID_INFO_CLASS (v5=-1073741821) when a2-4 path leads to v9!=0 && v9!=1; valid classes are 4,5,6; sogen checks object_info_class != 4 && !=5 && !=6 -> STATUS_INVALID_INFO_CLASS at object.cpp:760; fix is present
Kernel line 16-18: if (!SecurityDescriptor) return -1073741819 (STATUS_ACCESS_VIOLATION=0xC0000005); sogen: if (!security_descriptor) return STATUS_ACCESS_VIOLATION at object.cpp:885; fix is present
Kernel stub has no null-base check (passes to MiUnmapViewOfSection); sogen added if (!base_address) return STATUS_NOT_MAPPED_VIEW at section.cpp:567-569; fix is present
Kernel: if ((a3 & 0xFFFFFFFC) != 0) return STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER_3; sogen: if ((flags & 0xFFFFFFFC) != 0) return STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER_3 at section.cpp:624-626; flag check confirmed

Kernel: (count-1)>0x3F -> STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER_1; a3>1 -> STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER_3; sogen: count==0||count>64 -> STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER_1 and wait_type check at object.cpp:617-626; both count checks confirmed
Same (count-1)>0x3F and a3>1 checks as NtWaitForMultipleObjects; sogen mirrors the same validation at object.cpp:676-684
Kernel calls ObWaitForSingleObject directly; sogen calls resolve_wait_handle which invokes resolve_object_pseudo_handle for pseudo-handle expansion, then dispatches by handle type

Kernel: MiReadWriteVirtualMemory(a1,a5,32,0) — trivially delegates; sogen does bulk try_read_memory/try_write_memory returning STATUS_INVALID_ADDRESS on failure — kernel-trivial handler, sogen implementation is behavioral match
Kernel artifact line 6: MiObtainReferencedVadEx(a1, 2LL, &v20) confirms VAD dependency; stub deferral justified
Kernel artifact line 353: MiCfgMarkValidEntries(...) confirms CFG kernel dependency; stub deferral justified
Kernel artifact line 12: MiLockUnlockCommon(BugCheckParameter1, ...) confirms page-locking kernel dependency; stub deferral justified
